title: MV Skill Core custom requirement does not work and another weird (maybe) correlated bug.

posts.author: Arr222
posts.body:
Greetings and salutations, sages and scholars of the RPG Maker forums! I come to you in the time of great need.
My project has encountered two, crippling issues which cannot be overlooked. They are so bizarre and seemingly random that I truly have no way to detect the issue with my lacking knowledge of code-related matters.
Before further descriptions of the issue, I will attach my plugin list.
The heart of the trouble derives from the combat system I crafted. This combat system has three elements: Mastery, which is an armor, weapon class which that particular mastery grants access to and the basic attack skill adequate to the mastery.
Before divulging further into the truly disastrous glitch, let me disclose a smaller issue; equipment does not seem to update, and some actors seem "stuck" with a particular mastery in a skill no matter how many times I attempt to change that.
This can be easily bypassed by commands in-game, which whilst annoying and suboptimal fix the issue at hand... Or by leaving certain brackets in "armor" library empty. I mention this issue, because I do not know if it does or does not have correlation with the next bug I encountered.
Each weapon of a particular type grants all five basic attacks, but with help of "Yanfly's Skill Core", a basic attack can be accessed only in accordance to the level of mastery a character has. For example: if X has basic unarmed mastery, after equipping a ring he will be only allowed to access basic unarmed attack, instead of all five stages of it.
The issue is; that does not happen. No matter what I tried, all five skills remain locked.
However what makes this issue creepypasta-worthy, is that whenever testing in the "troops" category, the system almost works, but it gets stuck with only one of the five levels of mastery at random. And I am certain it is at random, because after I copied all the files, plugins and whatnot into a new project, instead of being permanently stuck on basic unarmed attack, now it is on master unarmed attack.
This issue singlehandedly sabotaged and halted any progress I can make on my project, as it strikes against the very essence of the combat system. I do not know what could be causing it: the fact I have 26 equipment slots/types? HIME plugins? The sun? Yanfly himself? I am ready to provide the files to the project, to anyone who is willing to help me solve the issue.
Thank you all in advance.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Given the number of plugins you're using, is this 26-equipment-slots system really the best-looking way to do this? It seems like you might be able to make something more user friendly using Yanfly's Equip Battle Skills or something.
Just a passing thought.
As far as all the stuff...I would suggest you go to each actor in the database, double click into their initial equipment slots, select None, and hit Ok. Sometimes changing things around in the database can leave old selections sort of stuck in there, even though you don't see anything.
Other things to try:
- Double check your order of Yanfly plugins in your plugin manager is correct according to the order they're listed on the Yanfly Engine Web page.
- Check one feature at a time by turning off
all
plugins except what you need to test that specific feature, saving your project, then starting a new game.

I followed through with your suggestion, and it seems "Yanfly's Equip Core" is the one causing all of the issues, alongside "Item Core". "Item Core" I do not care about, but I need a replacement for "Equip Core". Any reccomendations? HIME's does not work, I will say that now.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Arr222 said:
"Item Core" I do not care about, but I need a replacement for "Equip Core"
Click to expand...
That...is the wrong conclusion.
There is no problem using Yanfly's Equip Core alongside his other plugins. I (and dozens...hundreds?) of other people do it in our projects. They're specifically written to work together.
It's not a good idea to say "I have a problem so I'm going to say this plugin is defective and ditch it" - you need to actually troubleshoot why this is happening in your project, when it doesn't happen for other people.
Did you do
all
of the things I said? Did you check that everything is in the correct order? Did you check that you're using the newest version of all the plugins? What version is your project's code (seen at the top of the rpg_core file in your js folder)?

I would if "Equip Core" had big benefits to the project, but culling it will only affect how good one part of user interface looks, which is a minor loss.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
The point is any other plugin that does the same things you're using Equip Core is going to do them in basically the same way.
So if there's something screwy in your project that's causing bugs by Equip Core being included, you're most likely going to get the same screwy bugs by trying to use a different plugin (and you'll have had to change all of your notetags etc.).

I know, I am sorry. I am just getting tired by this error, because of how nonsensical it is. "Equip Core" and "Item Core" are causing an issue that seems so arbitrary, and so random that is genuinely makes no sense. It decides, seemingly at random, what armors to fixate on. I spoke about it before, but in a desperate attempt to solve the issue, I moved everything into a new RPG project, which caused it to fixate on new armors and new actors. Sometimes, the solution is just to leave certain brackets in the "Armor" library empty, and sometimes it just decides to jump to the next armor.
By all means, this does not operate like I was learned code operates.
